$schema.description: The JSON Schema version used for this schema.

writeOnly.description: Whether the value may be written but is never returned by the read API. Enforcement is not implemented: responses currently include write-only properties.

x-unique.description: The level of uniqueness for this property, if applicable

x-claim.description: The claim name for this property, if applicable

x-audit.description: Whether this property's value may appear in audit event payloads. Audit payloads are deny-by-default: a property without this annotation contributes its key but never its value.

properties.description: A map of additional properties for the user definition, where the key is the property name and the value is the property schema
